measures.title: Cherokee County Alcohol Referendum
measures.summary: Asks whether the South Carolina Department of Revenue may issue temporary permits in Cherokee County, for up to twenty-four hours, allowing bona fide nonprofit organizations and licensed on-premises businesses to possess, sell and serve alcoholic liquors by the drink. It also asks whether beer and wine may be sold at permitted off-premises locations without regard to the days or hours of sale.
measures.yesMeans: Temporary 24-hour liquor-by-the-drink permits could be issued in Cherokee County, and permitted stores could sell beer and wine without day or hour limits.
measures.noMeans: These temporary permits would not be authorized in Cherokee County, and current limits on the days and hours of beer and wine sales would stay in place.
